key.name: accent-color
key.description: Colour of the level meter, unread notifications, the open pill border and the play button, as #rrggbb. Tokyo Night blue by default.

key.name: pill-opacity
key.description: How opaque the pill background is, in percent. Lower lets more of the bar show through.

key.name: show-cover
key.description: Show the playing track's cover on the left of the clock.

key.name: show-meter
key.description: Show the three-bar level meter on the right of the clock while media plays.

key.name: open-on-hover
key.description: Open the media card when the pointer rests on the cover or the meter. When off, a click opens it.

key.name: hover-delay
key.description: How long the pointer has to rest on the cover or the meter before the card opens, in milliseconds.
